units.passage: Final Thoughts The Provost’s Office commits to working with schools, the Faculty Senate, other stakeholders, and the AI Initiative to provide regularly updated guidance, resources and professional development opportunities to assist faculty in navigating this new technological world. In that vein, we encourage faculty to confer with the Center for Teaching Excellence if they have questions about best practices for course design, pedagogy, assessment, and with Conflict Education & Student Accountability for questions about academic integrity. Given the extraordinary pace of change, the Provost’s Office will be engaging with deans, the Educational Policy and Technology Committee of the Faculty Senate, and other relevant stakeholders to inform updates of this guidance as circumstances require.
units.why: Faculty are encouraged to "confer with the Center for Teaching Excellence" on course design and assessment; faculty support, P63.
